# matterbridge_plugins (Data Source)

The plugins of Matterbridge and their status. The config is not here, because it can contain secrets. Use matterbridge_plugin for the config.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "matterbridge_plugins" "all" {}

output "plugin_versions" {
  value = { for p in data.matterbridge_plugins.all.plugins : p.name => p.version }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Nested Schema for `plugins`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `error` (Boolean) True if the plugin had an error.
- `latest_version` (String) The latest version on npm.
- `loaded` (Boolean)
- `name` (String) The npm package.
- `registered_devices` (Number) The number of devices that the plugin registered.
- `restart_required` (Boolean) True if the plugin has changes that apply after a restart.
- `started` (Boolean)
- `type` (String) DynamicPlatform or AccessoryPlatform.
- `version` (String) The installed version.
